assignments.name: topic
assignments.value: Docker Commands Every Developer Should Know

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "qwen2.5:7b",
  "prompt": "You are a technology content creator for the Keep Learning Lab channel.

Create a short TikTok script.

Topic:
{{ $json.topic }}

Rules:
- Maximum 100 words
- Hook in first 3 seconds
- Beginner-friendly
- Practical tips only
- Use simple language
- Focus on developers and IT professionals
- Main content must be suitable for voice-over narration
- Use complete spoken sentences
- Do not use emojis
- Do not use markdown
- Do not use bullet points
- Do not use code blocks
- Do not use special symbols
- End with: Keep learning. Keep building. Keep moving forward.
- Return JSON only

Return JSON in this schema:
{"title":"","hook":"","main_content":"","call_to_action":"","caption":""}",
  "stream": false
}

={
  "model": "qwen2.5:7b",
  "prompt": "You are an expert AI image prompt engineer.

Create one high-quality image generation prompt.

Your task is to convert technical learning content into a visually meaningful scene.

Title:
{{ $('Parse AI Response').item.json.title }}

Hook:
{{ $('Parse AI Response').item.json.hook }}

Main Content:
{{ $('Parse AI Response').item.json.main_content }}

Requirements:
- Create an image that directly illustrates the main concept being taught
- Focus on practical developer workflows, not generic technology environments
- Show the tools, interfaces, commands, or concepts being discussed
- If terminal commands are mentioned, show realistic terminal windows
- If coding is mentioned, show code editors or development environments
- If Docker is mentioned, include Docker containers, container orchestration diagrams, terminal commands, and software developer workstations
- If Git is mentioned, include version control workflows, branches, commits, and collaboration
- If cloud technologies are mentioned, include cloud architecture diagrams, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure dashboards

Visual Style:
- photorealistic
- modern developer workspace
- realistic computer screens
- professional lighting
- highly detailed
- cinematic composition
- educational and practical

Avoid:
- generic technology labs
- server rooms without context
- control centers
- futuristic cityscapes
- fantasy elements
- abstract technology imagery
- text overlays
- watermarks

Return JSON only:
{"image_prompt":""}",
  "stream": false
}
